title: Ukrainian-Style Phyllo Vareniki
description: A sweet and flaky pastry dessert filled with a sweet filling, inspired by traditional Ukrainian vareniki. This recipe combines the delicate taste of phyllo dough with the rich flavor of a sweet jelly filling.

instructions: Thaw the phyllo dough according to the package instructions.
Cut the phyllo dough into squares, about 3-4 inches per side.
Place a spoonful of jelly in the center of each square.
Fold the phyllo dough into a triangle or a square shape, pressing the edges to seal the filling inside.
Place the vareniki on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the vareniki with a little bit of water.
Bake the vareniki for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the vareniki warm, dust with powdered sugar if desired.
